lure: A grandchild sent you a verification code by mistake
ask: Send back the six-digit code you just received

message.body: Hi Grandma, sorry, I sent you my WhatsApp verification code by mistake. Can you send it back to me please? It's the 6-digit code you just received.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: Do not send the code.
reasons: The code opens your WhatsApp account to whoever gets it.
The number is not your grandchild's.
